text: His own bed. A ceiling of familiar rough beams. Late light. He has been gone a full day.

speaker: Essa
text: A full day. A full DAY, Kai.

speaker: Kai
text: The cave — Ma, there was a door, and a — a light—

speaker: Essa
text: I know about the light. The whole valley knows about the light.
His father stands by the window. Not looking at him. Looking down the road.
In the water basin, his own face — and faint on his brow, lines of green light, fine as a crown drawn by a jeweler. He touches it. It is warm.

speaker: Kai
text: What… what is it? Ma. What's happening to me?

speaker: Tam
text: Riders on the Vael road. Academy colors. They'll be here by dark.

speaker: Essa
text: Kai. Sit down. There's something we should have told you a long, long time ago.
